sentences.en: The hunter unexpectedly found fresh blood droplets in the snow.
sentences.zh: 猎人意外地在雪地上发现了新鲜的血液滴迹。

sentences.en: Masks can’t prevent droplets from getting into your eyes.
sentences.zh: 口罩无法阻止飞沫进入你的眼睛。

sentences.en: You can soak up the water droplets with a cloth.
sentences.zh: 你可以用布料吸收水滴。
